title: Six pointing-corrected column fits favor an image-scaled pattern for a selected KIC 8027456 brightening
abstract: We test the pixel distribution of a selected brightening before the known KIC 8027456 dip in Kepler release 25 quarter 15. We sum recorded detector columns and compare an image-scaled pattern with a uniform additive pattern. Six local fits with linear pointing terms favor the image-scaled pattern. The main coefficient is 100.8 parts per million of recorded-stamp flux, with an empirical control scale of 46.9 parts per million. One of 27 leave-one-out controls has an equal or larger pattern score. Fits without pointing terms give little spatial discrimination. Exact-pattern injections test the method, but the selected feature, small control set, mean-image approximation and pointing dependence prevent source identification. We establish no stellar event, dust scattering, new planet or comet. Code, saved numerical arrays, raw-data hashes, provenance, all fit and control tables, injections and offline instructions are included.
